 Order

This petition is filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. praying to enlarge the petitioner on bail in the event of his arrest in a case registered against him at Tumakuru Women Police Station in Cr.No.11/2023 for offences punishable under Sections 376 and 417 of IPC.

2. Heard the learned counsel for petitioner and the learned High Court Government Pleader and perused the material on record.
3.

It is alleged by the complainant/victim that she was in love with the petitioner since six months and he has committed sexual intercourse with her with a false promise of marriage, on account of which she is now four months pregnant.
It is alleged that when she requested the petitioner to marry her, he refused and thereby cheated her.
4. The learned counsel for petitioner has contended that, complainant is a married woman having a NC: 2023:KHC:21608 three year old daughter.
She has some dispute with her husband and in this regard a NCR dated 16.11.2022 has been registered on the complaint of her husband.

He contends that the allegations that the petitioner has committed rape on the complainant with a false promise of marriage etc., is a concocted story and the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case to grab his money.

5. As per complaint averments, since six months the complainant is in love with the petitioner and when there was nobody in the house, on the pretext of marriage, he committed sexual intercourse with her and made her pregnant and then refused to marry.
The complainant is a major aged about 22 years.
The ingredients of the offence alleged against the petitioner and the various allegations made in the complaint, have to be established by the prosecution during trial.
6. Admittedly, petitioner and complainant are known to each other.
Even according to the complainant there was a love affair.
Complainant's statement is NC: 2023:KHC:21608 already recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
In the facts and circumstances, petitioner can be directed to appear before I.O. and co-operate with the investigation of the case.

Accordingly, the following :
ORDER i. Petition is allowed.
ii. Petitioner/accused shall be released on bail in the event of his arrest in Cr.No.11/2023 registered at Tumakuru Women Police Station, subject to following B V Abhishek vs State Of Karnataka on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157475505/
2 conditions:
(1) He shall appear before the Investigation Officer within a period of one week from the date of receipt of a copy of the order and shall execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- [Rupees one lakh only] with one surety for the likesum.
